Query the Ensembl REST API

Source: R/analysis_information.R
queryEnsembl.Rd

Query the Ensembl REST API

Usage

queryEnsembl(path, query, grch37 = TRUE)

Arguments

path

Character: API path

query

Character: API query

grch37

Boolean: query the Ensembl GRCh37 API? if FALSE, query the most recent API

Value

Parsed response or NULL if no response

Examples

path  <- "overlap/region/human/7:140424943-140624564"
query <- list(feature = "gene")
psichomics:::queryEnsembl(path, query, grch37 = TRUE)
#>   assembly_name version canonical_transcript     start external_name strand
#> 1        GRCh37       8    ENST00000288602.6 140419127          BRAF     -1
#> 2        GRCh37       1    ENST00000605989.1 140583872            U6      1
#>                id seq_region_name       end         gene_id
#> 1 ENSG00000157764               7 140624564 ENSG00000157764
#> 2 ENSG00000271932               7 140583978 ENSG00000271932
#>                            logic_name feature_type        biotype
#> 1 ensembl_havana_gene_homo_sapiens_37         gene protein_coding
#> 2               ncrna_homo_sapiens_37         gene          snRNA
#>                                                                   description
#> 1 v-raf murine sarcoma viral oncogene homolog B [Source:HGNC Symbol;Acc:1097]
#> 2                               U6 spliceosomal RNA [Source:RFAM;Acc:RF00026]
#>           source

path  <- "lookup/symbol/human/BRCA2"
query <- list(expand=1)
psichomics:::queryEnsembl(path, query, grch37 = TRUE)
